note: Speakers are role labels. Adoption did not attend and sent no written update.

lines.speaker: Delivery manager
lines.text: Week two. Adoption have not dialled in and I have had nothing in writing from them, so we will come back to that.

lines.speaker: Platform lead
lines.text: Platform has had a good week. Contract review is closed out, ingress work is moving, the certificate runbook is under way.

lines.speaker: Delivery manager
lines.text: Still the twenty-fourth on the contract?

lines.speaker: Platform lead
lines.text: Still the twenty-fourth.

lines.speaker: Integration lead
lines.text: Field mapping is formally blocked now. I have marked it against the contract ticket rather than leave it looking like it is in flight.

lines.speaker: Integration lead
lines.text: Idempotency keys went the same way this week. Two tickets waiting on one platform ticket.

lines.speaker: Test lead
lines.text: Environment provisioning has gone past the integration milestone date. It has not been actioned and the milestone is now behind us.

lines.speaker: Delivery manager
lines.text: So this is no longer a question of whether. It has happened.

lines.speaker: Test lead
lines.text: It has happened. Integration and data migration both have to replan around it.

lines.speaker: Programme architect
lines.text: I will take the replan. I can have a revised sequence by the thirty-first.

lines.speaker: Data migration lead
lines.text: Referential integrity fixes are progressing. Reference data mapping is closed. Dry run two is loaded but not evaluated.

lines.speaker: Data migration lead
lines.text: Rollback rehearsal still has no owner and no date. I keep saying it and I keep not doing it.

lines.speaker: Delivery manager
lines.text: It is on the board as amber and I am going to keep it amber until that has a name on it.

lines.speaker: Reporting lead
lines.text: Reporting closed two defects this week, the duplicate rows and the timezone one.

lines.speaker: Reporting lead
lines.text: Finance keep adding requests. I am logging them all so we have the picture.

lines.speaker: Delivery manager
lines.text: Is the picture a problem?

lines.speaker: Reporting lead
lines.text: Not yet. We are keeping up more or less.

lines.speaker: Test lead
lines.text: The regression pack and the non-functional test plan have not moved in a fortnight. Both are mine and both have been squeezed out by the environment problem.

lines.speaker: Test lead
lines.text: The end-to-end scenario on migrated data is still blocked behind the rollback rehearsal.

lines.speaker: Delivery manager
lines.text: Adoption. Has anyone spoken to them this week?

lines.speaker: Programme architect
lines.text: Not me.

lines.speaker: Reporting lead
lines.text: Nor me.

lines.speaker: Delivery manager
lines.text: Then we do not know where adoption is, and I am not going to carry last week's line forward as if we did.

lines.speaker: Integration lead
lines.text: For the record, if the contract lands on the twenty-fourth we can still hold our dates. If it does not, we cannot.

lines.speaker: Delivery manager
lines.text: Understood. Board this afternoon. Adoption stays as reported because I have nothing to change it with, and I want that noted.
